smokePoof: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: reusable smoke poof VFX spritesheet for a small pixel art ninja RPG, top-down oblique camera. Neutral WHITE and LIGHT GRAY ninja substitution/summoning smoke only, no character, no log, no object, no fire, no magic glyphs, no colored energy or environment. Transparent RGBA. Exactly 8 square cells in a regular FOUR columns TWO rows grid, aspect 2:1, reading order left to right then next row, no grid lines or text. One compact billowy smoke cloud per cell. Frame 1 small clustered seed at lower center; frame2 rapidly blooms; frame3 dense opaque rounded cloud covering a human-sized silhouette; frame4 full cloud starts splitting; frame5 center opens into transparent hole with separate lobes moving outward; frame6 thinning disconnected lobes; frame7 sparse thin curling wisps; frame8 tiny final flecks. Same fixed ground anchor at x50% y80% of each cell, all smoke grows upward from this common point, maximal cloud occupies x15%-85% and y10%-80%, ample padding. Frame progression readable, soft round billows but rendered with crisp real pixel clusters, limited grayscale palette, no blur, no gradient glow, no heavy black outlines. Dominant white, light gray rim shadows. This one animation must work for both appearing and disappearing ninja-sized units, animals of similar size, transformations, and substitutions; no narrative-specific elements. Landscape 2:1 image, all eight cells equally spaced, no content crossing cell borders.
edoCoffin: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Edo Tensei summoning coffin opening animation for a SMALL PIXEL ART top-down oblique ninja RPG. Transparent RGBA, no environment or floor. Exactly EIGHT equal square cells, regular FOUR columns TWO rows grid, landscape 2:1 aspect, no visible grid or labels. Body of coffin always remains same geometry and fixed position, base at x55% y85%, height 65% of cell and width 28%; sufficient left/right space for opening lid. Object contained with generous transparent margin inside every cell; no cropped lid and no cell overlap. This is technical modular game art: one empty coffin sequence, no characters painted in it.
